summary: A labelled group of checkboxes, optionally led by a parent checkbox that checks and clears every one and sits indeterminate in between.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for screen readers and is shown above it.

props.name: parentLabel
props.description: Renders a checkbox above the group that checks and clears all of them, and is indeterminate while only some are checked. Needs `allValues`, and indents the group under it.

props.name: allValues
props.description: Every value in the group. Without it the parent cannot tell all-checked from some-checked.

props.name: value
props.description: The checked values, controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The checked values on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the checked values whenever they change.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction on every checkbox in the group.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for the parent checkbox.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the group's own classes, so a utility you pass wins.
